name: 左右直向流動圖片牆＋中間直排標題
desc: 左右兩面持續直向流動的錯位圖片牆，夾著中間一欄窄窄的直排標題與文字連結。
prompt: 建立一個高度剛好一個畫面的區塊。區塊分成三欄，橫跨整個畫面寬：左側圖片牆貼齊畫面左緣，右側圖片牆貼齊畫面右緣，左右沒有留邊；兩面圖片牆各約佔四成寬度，中間一欄約佔兩成，放標題組。每面圖片牆再分成三個等寬的小欄，每個小欄由多張直式圖片上下排列，圖片高度不一，相鄰小欄的圖片上下錯開，不排成整齊的列；圖片之間幾乎沒有間距，緊密排列。圖片牆持續往同一方向直向流動，循環不停；區塊上下不留白，圖片牆貼齊區塊的上下緣，最上與最下的圖片被區塊邊緣裁切。中間一欄的內容水平置中、在區塊內垂直置中，上下留大片空白：上方可放小標籤；下方是直書的標題，每個字元保持直立、由上往下排列，不是把橫排文字旋轉成直向，多行時成為並排的數個直行（可多行）；標題正下方、水平置中有一條短直向分隔線；分隔線下方置中是一個文字連結，下方有一條橫向底線、右端有小箭頭；小標籤與文字連結沒有時省略。標題字明顯小於圖片，只佔中間欄的一小部分。
mobile: 改為直向堆疊：上方一段圖片帶、中間標題組、下方一段圖片帶，高度改為依內容而定。每段圖片帶是兩列圖片，每列三張寬窄交錯（窄、寬、窄），圖片之間幾乎沒有間距，取消直欄錯位；圖片帶改為持續橫向流動，延伸到畫面右側邊緣並被裁切，上方那段貼齊區塊上緣、下方那段貼齊區塊下緣。標題組置中，直書標題改為橫排，短分隔線改為橫向、仍水平置中，文字連結橫跨內容寬度。

en.name: Vertically flowing image walls on both sides with a central vertical title
en.desc: Two staggered image walls that flow vertically and continuously on the left and right, framing a narrow central column with a vertical title and a text link.
en.prompt: Create a section that fills exactly one viewport. The section is split into three columns spanning the full viewport width: the left image wall is flush with the left edge of the viewport and the right image wall is flush with the right edge, with no side margins; each image wall takes about forty percent of the width, and the middle column takes about twenty percent and holds the heading group. Each image wall is split into three equal-width sub-columns, each made of multiple portrait images stacked vertically with varying heights; the images in neighboring sub-columns are staggered vertically and do not line up into rows; there is almost no gap between images, so they sit tightly packed. The image walls flow continuously in one vertical direction, looping without stopping; the section has no spacing at the top and bottom, the image walls are flush with the top and bottom edges of the section, and the topmost and bottommost images are cropped by the section edges. The content of the middle column is horizontally centered and vertically centered within the section, with large empty space above and below: optionally a label at the top; below it a title set vertically, with each character kept upright and running from top to bottom, not horizontal text rotated to read vertically, and multiple lines become several vertical columns side by side (may wrap to multiple lines); directly below the title, horizontally centered, is a short vertical divider; below the divider, centered, is a text link with a horizontal underline and a small arrow at its right end; omit the label and the text link when there is no content. The title text is clearly smaller than the images and takes only a small part of the middle column.
en.mobile: Stacks vertically: an image strip at the top, the heading group in the middle, and another image strip at the bottom; the height becomes determined by its content. Each image strip has two rows of images, with three images per row alternating narrow, wide, narrow, almost no gap between images, and the vertical stagger removed; the image strips instead flow continuously horizontally, extending to the right edge of the viewport and cropped by it, with the top strip flush with the top edge of the section and the bottom strip flush with its bottom edge. The heading group is centered, the vertical title becomes horizontal, the short divider becomes horizontal and stays horizontally centered, and the text link spans the content width.
